verses.1: And God remembered Noah and all the beasts and all the livestock that were with him in the ark. And God caused a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters subsided.
verses.2: The fountains of the deep and the windows of the heavens were closed, and the rain from the heavens was restrained.
verses.3: And the waters receded from the earth continually. At the end of 150 days the waters had decreased.
verses.4: And in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
verses.5: And the waters continued to decrease until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were seen.
verses.6: At the end of forty days Noah opened the window of the ark that he had made
verses.7: and sent out a raven. It went to and fro until the waters were dried up from the earth.
verses.8: Then he sent out a dove from him, to see if the waters had subsided from the face of the ground.
verses.9: But the dove found no resting place for the sole of her foot, and she returned to him in the ark, for the waters were still on the face of the whole earth. He reached out his hand and took her and brought her into the ark with him.
verses.10: He waited another seven days, and again he sent the dove out from the ark.
verses.11: And the dove came back to him in the evening, and behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters had subsided from the earth.
verses.12: Then he waited another seven days and sent out the dove, and she did not return to him anymore.
verses.13: In the six hundred and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried from off the earth. And Noah removed the covering of the ark and looked, and behold, the face of the ground was dry.
verses.14: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth had dried out.
verses.15: Then God spoke to Noah, saying,
verses.16: "Go out from the ark, you and your wife, and your sons and your sons' wives with you.
verses.17: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh — birds and animals and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth — that they may swarm on the earth and be fruitful and multiply on the earth."
verses.18: So Noah went out, and his sons and his wife and his sons' wives with him.
verses.19: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every bird, everything that moves on the earth, went out by families from the ark.
verses.20: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD and took some of every clean animal and some of every clean bird and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.21: And when the LORD smelled the pleasing aroma, the LORD said in His heart, "I will never again curse the ground because of man, for the intention of man's heart is evil from his youth. Neither will I ever again strike down every living creature as I have done.
verses.22: While the earth remains, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night, shall not cease."

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
